title: Best Zendesk Alternatives
intro: Zendesk's omnichannel consolidation is genuinely the best-reviewed part of the product, but G2 specifically flags Ease of Setup as its weakest metric, and AI Agents don't even unlock until the $55/agent/mo Suite Team tier. These are the alternatives worth checking if you want less complexity.

entries.blurb: Cheaper to start ($29/seat/mo vs. $55/agent/mo for AI-enabled tiers) and faster to deploy via a standalone Fin AI Agent that bolts onto your existing helpdesk without a full migration.
A genuinely lighter option for small-to-mid teams — per-workspace pricing from $45/mo, live chat and shared inbox without Zendesk's ticketing depth or learning curve.
If Zendesk's setup complexity is the dealbreaker, Tidio's Lyro AI agent is consistently the top-praised attribute in its own reviews for exactly that reason — fast, low-friction setup.
